name: Caveman (plugin)
summary: Third-party terse-output rules as a plugin. Held: the built-in Concise style does the same job without an install, and paired tests disagree on any saving. Its agent hooks send usage stats by default since v3.0.0. About 1,000 always-loaded tokens by its own v7-era estimate. Its CLI, proxy and cloud router are a separate Reject (caveman-cli).

evidence.effect: Output tokens -8.5%; about 10% of cost at best

evidence.setting: Caveman's own test, n = 10, against an "Answer concisely." control; output size only, so no higher than E5
evidence.effect: Output only 3% smaller than the control

evidence.source: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/issues/727 (Benchmark results and three questions - 0 savings E2E)

evidence.effect: The CLI and its agent hooks send usage stats with a random install ID and the IP address, on by default

egress.default: usage stats with a random install ID and the IP address, on by default since v3.0.0
egress.optional: the CLI's Caveman Cloud router (see caveman-cli)

revisit: an independent paired test shows lower cost per accepted task than Concise
maintenance: Third-party plugin with frequent releases (v4.0.1 on 2026-10-13).
